Report this job Job Title Frontend Architect Job Description Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Frontend Architect to lead the technical strategy and design of our next-generation web applications. In this role, you will champion the adoption of the latest Angular frameworks, drive the transition to a robust micro-frontend architecture , and establish a scalable UI ecosystem using Atomic Design principles. While your primary domain will be the frontend, you will work closely with our backend engineering teams. Therefore, a strong working knowledge of Java Spring Boot and Domain-Driven Design (DDD) is essential to ensure seamless integration and architectural alignment across the entire stack. Key Responsibilities Architectural Leadership: Design, architect, and implement scalable frontend solutions using the latest versions of Angular (standalone components, signals, strictly typed reactive forms, etc.). Micro-Frontend Strategy: Lead the migration and development of our applications into a Micro-Frontend architecture (using Webpack Module Federation, single-spa, or similar techniques) to enable independent deployment and scaling by autonomous teams. UI/UX Standardization: Establish and enforce a UI component library built strictly on Atomic Design principles (Atoms, Molecules, Organisms, Templates, Pages) to ensure high reusability, consistency, and maintainability across all digital products. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Bridge the gap between frontend and backend systems. Work closely with backend architects to design API contracts and align frontend modules with backend microservices built on Java Spring Boot. Domain-Driven Design (DDD) Alignment: Translate complex business rules into technical architecture, ensuring frontend bounded contexts map logically to backend DDD structures. Mentorship & Governance: Mentor senior and lead developers, conduct rigorous code reviews, and define coding standards, testing practices, and CI/CD pipelines for frontend artifacts. Performance Optimization: Continuously monitor and improve application performance, bundle sizes, rendering strategies (SSR/SSG), and core web vitals. Required Qualifications Experience: 14+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 4+ years in a Lead or Architectural role focusing on frontend technologies. Angular Expertise: Deep, hands-on mastery of the latest Angular ecosystem, RxJS, NgRx (or similar state management), and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. Pattern Proficiency: Proven experience designing and implementing Micro-Frontend architectures at an enterprise scale. Component Design: Extensive experience building highly modular UI libraries utilizing the Atomic Design pattern, integrating with tools like Storybook. Testing & Tooling: Strong background in frontend testing strategies (Jest, Cypress, Playwright) and modern build tools (Webpack, Vite, esbuild). Required Backend & Systems Awareness Java Spring Boot: Familiarity with Java and Spring Boot ecosystems. You don't need to write backend code daily, but you must be able to read it, review it, and effectively collaborate with backend developers on API design. Domain-Driven Design (DDD): Strong conceptual understanding of DDD concepts (Entities, Aggregates, Bounded Contexts, Ubiquitous Language) to align frontend architecture with the backend domain model. API Design: Experience consuming and helping design RESTful APIs Diversity & inclusion Toyota Automated Logistics is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. Report this job Direct message the job poster from Chargebee Prakash Selvakumar Prakash Selvakumar TA-Talent Acquisition | Technical Recruiter | Sourcer | Talent Partner | SAAS | Technology Hiring About Chargebee Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth. Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2. With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe. About the Team Our AI Products team is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build Chargebee Copilot and other product experiences that bring Chargebee's AI Agents platform to real users. This is a true full-stack role. You'll write backend services in Python/FastAPI and build the UI in React/TypeScript, and you'll move between the two depending on what the work needs. You'll build products that use Chargebee's AI Agents platform, turning its agents, tools, and APIs into things people use every day. That means designing and building the APIs that power these products along with the screens on top of them. If you care about good conversational experiences and want to build both the backend logic and the interfaces that let people configure and improve how an AI agent behaves, this role is for you. About the role You'll be working on: Chargebee Copilot — the conversational AI experience our users interact with, both backend and frontend Tools for configuring and testing AI agents, including the APIs and services behind them, so teams can build and tune agent behavior Think about what it takes to design a clean API for agent configuration, wire it up to the platform underneath, and then build the interface that makes all of it usable for a business user with no code. That's the kind of work you'll be doing end to end What you'll do (role and responsibilities) Design, build, and scale APIs (Fast API) that power Chargebee Copilot and related AI product tools Build the backend services that connect the UI to the AI Agents platform's APIs and MCP tools Build fast, responsive UI in React/TypeScript for chat and agent configuration screens, including streaming responses, rich text editing, and live previews Turn product requirements into clean code across both the backend and frontend Own your modules end to end, from API design through UI implementation to production support Work closely with designers, PMs, and the platform team to ship good AI experiences Improve performance, reliability, and security for real-time, LLM-backed services Help improve team practices through code reviews and shared learning. What you'll bring (required skills and experience) 4 to 6 years of hands-on software development experience Strong backend skills in Python (Fast API or similar), including designing and building scalable async APIs Strong React/TypeScript skills, especially building dynamic, real time UIs with streaming and state management Genuine full stack range — you're equally comfortable owning a backend service and the UI in front of it Good debugging skills and attention to detail across the stack A product mindset — you care about why you're building something, not just how Comfort working with a platform or API you don't own, including reading docs and working within someone else's contracts and constraints Good to have: some working understanding of how agents and tools fit together in the LLM world — things like tool calling, agent-to-agent or agent-to-tool communication, and how context gets passed around in these systems Bonus points for experience building products on top of LLM platforms or AI agent frameworks, or for building the backend and UI for builder style tools like form builders or workflow editors How you will work with AI Daily hands-on use of AI coding tools, and a good sense of when they help and when they don't A clear line between AI-generated code and production-ready code — you review, test, and own everything you ship The ability to write clear, specific prompts that get consistent, good output from LLMs A habit of breaking work into small, reviewable chunks instead of accepting large AI-generated changes all at once Genuine curiosity about how agents, tool calling, and conversational UX work under the hood Benefits we offer At Chargebee, we believe that feeling supported is the foundation for doing great work.
